messages:
Rae (DevRel): Quick heads-up planning a small community build lab: short tutorial + reference app showing low-latency inference on Redwood Dedicated + a 30-min webinar. Need: blog post, benchmark blurb, tutorial repo, webinar page, and inbound lead routing. Who volunteers for what?

Liam (Content): I can draft the blog + 3 social cards. Need a 1-line TL;DR for the hero and the bench numbers (p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens).

Asha (Growth): For routing let's use a gated signup -> HubSpot tag "mini-build-lab". If they spin up and use >75k tokens in 5 days, assign to AE queue; otherwise drip. Thoughts on the 75k threshold?

Tom (PM): Confirmed we can publish A10G hardware and that the bench uses redwood-medium-v1 with FP16 + q4_0 for the quantized variant. Add a small section on when teams should use Dedicated vs Hosted.

Nina (Ops): I can create the webinar form + registration page. Prefer Wed 10am PT. Will need speaker bios and a 45min slot (10min intro / 20min demo / 15min Q&A).

Rae (DevRel): Proposed breakdown: Liam = blog + socials; me = tutorial repo + demo script; Asha = HubSpot flow; Tom = product review; Nina = webinar logistics. I'll do the dry-run two days before.

Liam (Content): Draft PR: github.com/redwood/content/pulls/189 I'll link the bench graphs once Sam uploads them. Hero TL;DR candidate: "Learn how to run sub-100ms p50 inference on Redwood Dedicated and cut per-token cost by 3x with caching and quantization."

Asha (Growth): HubSpot draft mapping:```yaml
lead_source: "mini-build-lab"
tags: ["mini-build-lab"]
assign_if: "tokens_used_5d > 75000"
assign_to: "AE_inbound"
nurture_list: "mini-lab-nurture"
```Also adding UTMs for socials and webinar invites.

Tom (PM): 75k seems fine. Also confirm we can share the sample traffic profile (50% short prompts, 50% long) in the blog. That helps the bench interpretation.

Nina (Ops): Booked Wed 10am PT tentatively. Zoom + calendar will be shared when final copy approved.

Rae (DevRel): Tutorial repo plan: small Flask app + Dockerfile + example rdctl commands. Will include a minimal dataset and a script to reproduce benches. Example run:```bash
rdctl serve --dedicated --pool small-pool --model redwood-medium-v1 --quant q4_0
rdctl run-bench --seq 256 --batch 4 --warmup 500 --duration 300
```Will push initial repo by Tue.

Liam (Content): Please add a short customer-style quote if anyone has one from the beta users. Otherwise we'll use a community quote.

Asha (Growth): For the AE flow: include a webhook that posts lead + token usage to our inbound Slack channel so AEs can triage. I'll set that up after the form is live.

publish-bot: Calendar event created: "Mini Build Lab  Wed 10am PT" -> https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3339876543

Tom (PM): I'll do product signoff on the draft blog by Tue EOD. Minor note: avoid saying "sub-100ms" unless p50 is actually <100ms in the final bench.

Nina (Ops): Shared registration page (draft) in the calendar event. Needs copy and final speaker names.

Rae (DevRel): I'll coordinate a 25-min dry-run Tue 4pm PT. Also will prepare a 90-second GIF of the demo for the blog.

Liam (Content): :thumbsup: will review the repo and bench artifacts once they're uploaded.

Asha (Growth): Once reg page is live I'll wire HubSpot + webhook and post the UTM templates.

Rae (DevRel): Thanks team  let's sync Wed morning if any blocker crops up.
